About this item

  • SOFT FABRIC Crafted from an 82% Polyester, 12% Rayon, 6% Spandex blend that feels lightweight and breathable against the skin. The 4-way stretch fabric moves with you and holds its shape through everyday wear
  • CREWNECK DESIGN The classic crewneck and short sleeves create a clean, simple silhouette that works as a standalone top or a smooth base layer. The solid color and straight hem keep the look easy to style for casual outings and everyday life
  • STRETCH COMFORT The 6% Spandex content gives this tee a flexible stretch that moves with you from office hours to casual weekends. Designed to fit comfortably without feeling tight, it keeps you at ease through long days of wear
  • VERSATILE STYLING Wear it solo with jeans, shorts, or skirts, or layer it under a blazer, cardigan, or denim jacket when the temperature drops. A basic go-to piece that fits into your wardrobe for casual outings, travel days, and everyday life
  • EASY CARE Machine wash cold, tumble dry low — the polyester blend is designed to hold its color and shape wash after wash. Whether you are heading to the office or catching an early flight, this airport-ready tee keeps you looking fresh with minimal effort

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

A nice basic tee that fits well.
I’ve been wearing these exact shirts for several years for work as a home health nurse. They hold up for a really long time, don’t shrink and the color doesn’t fade. Eventually, after over a year of weekly wear, they kind of start to develop pills in certain areas so I just retire them then. They are super comfy. I can move easily in them and they don’t make me too hot. The fabric is thinish in a good way. It drapes nicely over the chest and feels comfortable in the shoulders and underarm area. The length is also perfect for me. I am 5’ 6 1/2” for reference and weigh 175 lbs with a bit of a tummy. I don’t like a short shirt or one that’s too long. I can easily reach, squat or bend all the way down to touch my toes without the shirt riding up too high in the front or back. I wear a size large. I am big busted and these fit fine for the girlies. I do wear a smooth bra underneath and it doesn’t show. Certain bras will show if they bulge out at all. It is, however, not see through at all. I just mean you can see little bumps with certain bras. I would say it’s a looser fitting, lightweight, casual tee shirt and the pics shown are accurate. As long as they keep making them I will continue to buy them. Be aware that they do go on sale. I wait for sales and stock up because their sale prices are unbelievable. I just got a bunch of them for $8.99 each. Different colors are different prices though so you may have to pay more for a specific color if you want it. Sorry but these work selfies are the only pics I have while wearing them but still thought they might be helpful to someone to see the fit.

About this Item

  • SOFT FABRIC Crafted from an 82% Polyester, 12% Rayon, 6% Spandex blend that feels lightweight and breathable against the skin. The 4-way stretch fabric moves with you and holds its shape through everyday wear
  • CREWNECK DESIGN The classic crewneck and short sleeves create a clean, simple silhouette that works as a standalone top or a smooth base layer. The solid color and straight hem keep the look easy to style for casual outings and everyday life
  • STRETCH COMFORT The 6% Spandex content gives this tee a flexible stretch that moves with you from office hours to casual weekends. Designed to fit comfortably without feeling tight, it keeps you at ease through long days of wear
  • VERSATILE STYLING Wear it solo with jeans, shorts, or skirts, or layer it under a blazer, cardigan, or denim jacket when the temperature drops. A basic go-to piece that fits into your wardrobe for casual outings, travel days, and everyday life
  • EASY CARE Machine wash cold, tumble dry low — the polyester blend is designed to hold its color and shape wash after wash. Whether you are heading to the office or catching an early flight, this airport-ready tee keeps you looking fresh with minimal effort

Product Description

Soft, breathable oversized tee for relaxed spring/summer style. Easy-care fabric, ideal for beach or casual wear
